expandObjectName.description: Prefix the name of the ListenerSet with the release fullname.

namespace.description: Namespace of the ListenerSet. Defaults to the release namespace.

annotationsList.description: Additional annotations as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the annotations

labelsList.description: Additional labels as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the labels

targetSelector.description: Name of a gateway in this chart to attach to. Takes the place of `parentRef`, the gateway must set `allowedListeners.namespaces.from`.

group.description: API group of the parent Gateway.

name.description: Name of the parent Gateway, supports Helm `tpl`. Required unless `targetSelector` is set.

namespace.description: Namespace of the parent Gateway, supports Helm `tpl`. Defaults to the namespace of the listener set.

parentRef.description: The Gateway to attach to, when `targetSelector` is not used.

items.description: A listener added to the Gateway, same format as a listener of a Gateway.

listeners.description: Listeners that are added to the Gateway, same format as `gateway.$name.listeners`.

description: ListenerSets, keyed by name. Every enabled entry renders a Gateway API `ListenerSet`, see [ListenerSet](/truecharts-common/listenerSet).
